kypExtensions.summary: The three-medium-jobs model (enrich = supply what the bug cannot make / select = poison everything else / indicate = report metabolism as color) applied row by row; the chocolate-agar lysis explanation ('heated blood releases V and X'); the Thayer-Martin as a Neisseria gate; the colonies-not-plate clarification for MacConkey; and the negative-culture-on-wrong-plate principle — with the Sabouraud low-pH mechanism and the heated-blood extension labeled as extensions.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source lists the directory without the design taxonomy or the mechanisms behind the media; these integrations are KYP's design.
